claim: Patchline ships a separation-logic model of concurrent migrations proving freedom from lost-update anomalies. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the separation-logic claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make separation-logic-migrations-gate`.
